job.question: One RFP for investment manager services, issued by an education foundation, limits proposals to five single-spaced typewritten pages. How many copies must be submitted and by what deadline?
job.expected_facts: Six copies, no later than 5 PM on July 1, 2016 (Broward Education Foundation).
job.acceptance: Require six copies, July 1, 2016, 5 p.m.; issuer/addressee optional. No timezone is stated, so do not require one.

reviews.reason: This is a Boston Retirement System RFP for actuarial and consulting services, not the education foundation’s investment-manager RFP. It requires one original and five copies, with a September 2022 deadline; it does not support the requested deadline or six copies.
quotes: Request for Proposal Actuarial and Consulting Services for Pension Benefits Boston Retirement System September 12, 2022
Please submit one (1) original and five (5) copies of the Proposal to:
All proposals must be received no later than Noon EST on September 26, 2022
